comment.body: Thanks for the source-level observation and for confirming that the issue is not limited to the bottom taskbar. The current bottom predicate does lack an upper Y bound, but the suggested clamp has not been tested in the full app and may not explain the other positions. Please list each additional dock/taskbar edge that reproduces, the monitor resolution/scaling, and whether the pointer remains stationary while the dock flashes. This will distinguish a shared hit-region mismatch from separate geometry transitions before a fix is chosen.
